audit.description: Changed production code in resend/request.py removes the direct requests import and imports pycurl instead. The same file meaningfully uses the real pycurl API via pycurl.Curl(), setopt calls such as pycurl.URL, pycurl.HTTPHEADER, pycurl.WRITEFUNCTION, pycurl.HEADERFUNCTION, pycurl.CUSTOMREQUEST, pycurl.POSTFIELDS, curl.perform(), and curl.getinfo(pycurl.RESPONSE_CODE). Deterministic dynamic evidence also records pycurl imported from the installed site-packages extension module, with no requests imports from production repo and no local target provider detected.
